Custom Values

Custom values are like personalized settings that you can adjust to make your experience with our snapshot uniquely yours. They give you the power to tailor how the snapshot behaves, ensuring it fits your needs perfectly. Whether it's tweaking configurations or fine-tuning outputs, custom values empower you to make the snapshot work just the way you want it to.

If you go to Settings, then Custom Values, you will see the values we have for you. For each value, you can simply click the three dots on the side of each section to add your own value to the custom values.

Whatever you add to these values will update the entire snapshot with that information, whether it pertains to your website, funnels, automations, emails, and more.

Your Pressure Washer Custom Values:

Customer Referral Offer:

Description: Input the offer for your customer referral program. This incentive encourages existing customers to refer new clients to your pressure washing services.

DR Campaign Offer:

Description: Add the offer for your DR (Direct Response) campaign. This offer will automatically update within your DR campaign workflow, driving engagement and conversions.

Free Quote Calendar Link:

Description: Provide the calendar link for scheduling free pressure washing quotes. This link enables potential customers to easily book appointments for quotes and estimates.

Funnel Offer:

Description: Customize the offer for your pressure washer funnels. By updating this value, you can tailor specific offers or promotions within your marketing funnels to attract and convert leads.

Google Review Link (Continuous Reputation Management):

Description: Insert the Google review link for continuous reputation management. This link facilitates ongoing review collection and management to build and maintain a positive online reputation.

After Service Google Review Link ⭐:

Description: This link is provided to customers after service completion for leaving reviews. It encourages satisfied customers to share their feedback, helping to bolster your business's reputation.

Google Review Link (Review Campaign):

Description: Add the Google review link for your review campaign. This link will be utilized to solicit reviews from customers as part of your targeted review acquisition efforts.

Google Review Campaign Review Link ⭐:

Description: Offered as part of your review campaign, this link prompts customers to leave reviews. It helps streamline the review collection process and enhances your online credibility.

Holiday Email Offer:

Description: Customize the offer you wish to run within your holiday email campaigns. This offer can be tailored to align with seasonal promotions or special deals during holiday periods.

Service Area:

Description: Specify the service area for your pressure washing business. This value helps ensure accurate targeting and communication with potential customers within your operational region.

2. Pipelines

In our pressure washer snapshot, we provide three dedicated sales pipelines to streamline your lead management and customer engagement processes. Here's a breakdown of each pipeline and its respective stages:

Pressure Wash Pipeline

New Lead In:

Description: Initial stage for newly acquired leads.

Hot Lead (Lead Responded):

Description: Leads that have responded positively to initial outreach or inquiries.

Appt Booked:

Description: Leads who have scheduled appointments for pressure washing services.

Appt No Show:

Description: Leads who did not show up for scheduled appointments.

Appt Canceled:

Description: Leads who have canceled scheduled appointments.

Follow Up:

Description: Subsequent follow-up stage for nurturing and re-engaging leads.

Customer Serviced:

Description: Leads who have received pressure washing services.

Google Review Campaign Pipeline

Request Sent:

Description: Initial stage indicating the request for a Google review has been sent to the customer.

Review Link Clicked:

Description: Leads who have clicked on the Google review link provided.

Review Link NOT Clicked:

Description: Leads who have not clicked on the Google review link provided.

Database Reactivation Pipeline

Offer Sent:

Description: Stage indicating that an offer has been sent to re-engage dormant leads.

Lead Responded:

Description: Leads who have responded positively to the reactivation offer.

Appt Booked:

Description: Leads who have scheduled appointments after responding to the reactivation offer.

Not Interested:

Description: Leads who have indicated disinterest or declined the reactivation offer.

Understanding Automated Calendars

Automated calendars serve as powerful tools to streamline scheduling processes, improve organization, and enhance productivity for businesses. Snapshot Pressure Washing Calendar

Appointment Confirmation, Reminders, no-show, & Cancellation Automation

In our pressure washer snapshot, we offer comprehensive appointment automations for the Free Quote Calendar to streamline the confirmation, reminders, handling of no-shows, and cancellations. Here's how these automations work:

Appointment Confirmation:

Upon booking an appointment through the Free Quote Calendar, customers will receive an automated confirmation email or text message. This ensures that their appointment is successfully scheduled and confirmed, providing them with peace of mind and reassurance.

Reminders:

Prior to the scheduled appointment, automated reminders will be sent to customers to minimize the risk of no-shows. These reminders can be customized to be sent at specific intervals before the appointment time, ensuring that customers are well-prepared and ready for their appointment.

No-show Management:

In the event of a no-show, the system will automatically tag the customer accordingly. This allows you to follow up and reschedule as needed to minimize disruptions to your schedule and workflow.

Cancellation Handling:

If a customer cancels their appointment, the system will update their status accordingly. This ensures that you can manage your calendar effectively and allocate resources efficiently. Additionally, you can automate the process of sending cancellation confirmations to customers to maintain transparency and communication.

Appointment Automations for Pressure Washing Calendar

Similarly, the Pressure Washing Calendar is equipped with appointment automations to facilitate confirmation, reminders, handling of no-shows, and cancellations. Here's how these automations function:

Appointment Confirmation:

Reminders:

Automated reminders will be sent to customers prior to their scheduled appointments, reducing the likelihood of no-shows and ensuring that customers are prepared and ready for their pressure washing services.

8. Database Reactivation

Understanding Database Reactivation Campaigns

Database reactivation campaigns are strategic marketing initiatives aimed at re-engaging with inactive or lapsed leads in your database. These campaigns help revitalize your contact list, rekindle interest in your products or services, and ultimately drive conversions. In our snapshot, we offer two types of database reactivation campaigns: a basic version and an advanced version, each offering unique features and functionalities.

Snapshot Database Reactivation Campaigns

Basic Database Reactivation Campaign: The basic campaign provides a straightforward approach to reactivating dormant leads in your database. You have the flexibility to customize the offer for this campaign using a custom value. This campaign aims to reconnect with inactive leads, remind them of your value proposition, and encourage them to re-engage with your business.

Advanced Database Reactivation Campaign (DR Campaign): The advanced campaign takes database reactivation to the next level by incorporating dynamic lead management features. Similar to the basic campaign, you can customize the offer using a custom value. However, this campaign goes a step further by updating leads in a dedicated DR campaign pipeline. If a lead responds positively to the campaign, they will be moved to a "responded" status in the pipeline, indicating active interest. Conversely, if they indicate disinterest, they will be moved to a "not interested" status, allowing you to focus your efforts on more promising leads.

10. Referral Campaign Workflow

Referral campaigns are powerful marketing strategies designed to leverage the existing customer base to acquire new customers. By incentivizing customers to refer friends, family, or colleagues to your business, referral campaigns can rapidly expand your customer network and drive growth. In our snapshot, we offer a comprehensive referral campaign feature that enables you to easily create and manage referral programs tailored to your business needs.

Snapshot Referral Campaign

Customizable Referral Incentives: Our referral campaign feature allows you to customize the incentives offered to customers for referring new business. By utilizing custom values, you can tailor the incentives to align with your promotional strategies and budget. Whether it's offering discounts, freebies, or exclusive rewards, the referral campaign feature empowers you to create compelling incentives that motivate customers to spread the word about your business.

Benefits of Referral Campaigns

Expanded Customer Base: Referral campaigns tap into the power of word-of-mouth marketing to attract new customers. By leveraging the networks of your existing customers, you can rapidly expand your customer base and drive growth for your business.

Enhanced Trust and Credibility: Recommendations from friends or family members are highly trusted by consumers. By encouraging referrals, you can capitalize on this trust and credibility to attract high-quality leads and convert them into loyal customers.

Cost-Effective Marketing: Referral campaigns are a cost-effective way to acquire new customers compared to traditional advertising channels. Since referrals come from satisfied customers, the cost per acquisition is typically lower, resulting in a higher return on investment.

With our customizable referral campaign feature, you can harness the power of word-of-mouth marketing to drive growth and success for your business.

11. Incoming Lead Follow Up Workflows

Incoming lead follow-up workflows are automated processes designed to promptly respond to inquiries and messages from potential customers across various communication channels. These workflows ensure that every lead receives a timely and personalized response, increasing the chances of conversion and providing exceptional customer service. In our snapshot, we offer four incoming lead follow-up workflows tailored to different communication channels: Google My Business (GMB) message, email, Facebook message, and Instagram direct message (DM).

Snapshot Incoming Lead Follow-Up Workflows

GMB Message Workflow: This workflow is triggered when someone sends a message through your Google My Business listing. The workflow automatically tags the lead, updates their status in the pipeline as responded to, and notifies the pressure washing business. You can easily customize the messaging and actions of this workflow to suit your preferences and brand voice.

Email Workflow: The email workflow is activated when a lead reaches out via email. Similar to the GMB message workflow, it tags the lead, updates their status, and notifies the pressure washer, ensuring a prompt and efficient response to email inquiries.

Facebook Message Workflow: When a potential customer sends a message to your Facebook page, the Facebook message workflow springs into action. It tags the lead, updates their status, and alerts the pressure washer, enabling seamless communication and follow-up through Facebook Messenger.

Instagram DM Workflow: The Instagram DM workflow handles incoming direct messages on your Instagram account. It automatically tags the lead, updates their status, and notifies the pressure washing business, facilitating quick and effective engagement with potential customers on Instagram.

With our incoming lead follow-up workflows, you can effectively manage inquiries and messages across multiple communication channels, providing timely and personalized responses to potential customers.

12. Reputation Management

Reputation management is crucial for maintaining a positive image and credibility for your pressure washing business. It involves actively monitoring and influencing how your brand is perceived by customers, both online and offline. In our snapshot, we offer comprehensive reputation management features to help you proactively manage and enhance your online reputation.

Snapshot Reputation Management Features

Ongoing Reputation Management: After each service, customers have the option to request a review. This process allows you to gather feedback and testimonials from satisfied customers, helping to boost your online reputation and credibility.

Google Review Campaign: Our Google review campaign is designed to generate a significant number of new reviews for your pressure washing business. You can input a list of existing customers into the campaign to kickstart the process, resulting in 30-100 new reviews right away. Customers in this campaign are managed through a dedicated review campaign pipeline, allowing you to track who has left a review and who hasn't.

Key Features and Customization Options

Custom Review Links: The review link for both ongoing reputation management and the Google review campaign can be customized using custom values. This allows you to tailor the review links to your branding and preferences.

Trigger Links: Each campaign includes two trigger links that serve as indicators of customer engagement. These trigger links, associated with the review custom value links, help you track whether customers have clicked on the review links or not, if clicked they will no longer get review reminders and so on.

13. Invoice Reminders, Cancellation, & Refunds

Automation for invoice management streamlines the process of handling invoices, reminders, cancellations, and refunds, ensuring smooth and efficient financial transactions for your pressure washing business. These automated workflows help you stay organized, reduce administrative burden, and provide a seamless experience for your customers.

Snapshot Automation for Invoice Management

Invoice Reminders Automation: This automation sends timely reminders to customers who have outstanding invoices, prompting them to make payment. By automating invoice reminders, you can minimize late payments, improve cash flow, and maintain positive relationships with your customers.

Cancellation Automation: When a customer cancels a service or appointment, this automation ensures that the cancellation process is handled smoothly and efficiently. It updates the customer's status, triggers any necessary refunds, and notifies relevant stakeholders, allowing you to manage cancellations with ease and professionalism.

Refunds Automation: In cases where refunds are warranted, this automation handles the refund process seamlessly. It initiates the refund, updates the customer's status accordingly, and provides notifications to both the customer and your team, ensuring transparency and accountability in the refund process.

Key Features and Customization Options

Timely Notifications: Each automation sends timely notifications to customers and stakeholders, keeping them informed throughout the invoicing, cancellation, and refund processes.

Customizable Messaging: You have the flexibility to customize the messaging of each automation to align with your branding and communication style, ensuring a consistent and professional experience for your customers.

14. Missed Call Text Back

The Missed Call Text Back Automation is a proactive response system designed to engage with potential leads who have attempted to contact the pressure washing business but were unable to connect via phone. This automation sends a text message to the missed caller, providing them with an opportunity to book a consultation or appointment with your business. By leveraging this automation, you can effectively follow up with missed leads and encourage them to take the next step towards becoming customers.

Snapshot Missed Call Text Back Automation

Engagement Text Message: When a call goes unanswered or is missed, the automation triggers a text message to be sent to the caller's phone number. The message is crafted to be engaging and inviting, encouraging the caller to consider booking a consultation or appointment with your pressure washing business.

Call to Action: The text message includes a clear call to action, such as a link to your online booking system or a phone number to call back, making it easy for the recipient to take immediate action and schedule a consultation.

Personalization: To enhance engagement and relevance, the text message can be personalized with the caller's name or other relevant details, creating a more personalized and tailored experience for the recipient.
